story.iWant: to reset my password if I forget it
story.soThat: I can regain access to my account
story.tasks: - [x] **Task 1: Implement "Forgot Password" UI (AC: All)** - [x] Add "Forgot Password" link on the login page. - [x] Create a UI for entering email address for password reset. - [x] Display messages to the user (e.g., "Check your email", "Link expired"). - [x] Create a UI for setting a new password. - [x] Implement client-side validation for new password strength. - [x] **Task 2: Implement Password Reset API Endpoints (AC: All)** - [x] Create a Next.js API route to initiate password reset (e.g., `src/app/api/auth/reset-password/request/route.ts`). - [x] Call Supabase Auth function to send password reset email. - [x] Create a Next.js API route to handle password update (e.g., `src/app/api/auth/reset-password/confirm/route.ts`). - [x] Call Supabase Auth function to update user's password. - [x] Implement server-side validation for new password strength. - [x] **Task 3: Testing (AC: All)** - [x] Write unit tests for UI components and client-side validation. - [x] Write integration tests for API endpoints: - Initiating password reset (email sending). - Confirming password reset (setting new password). - [x] Write end-to-end tests for the complete password reset flow (dependent on registration and login). - [x] Manual testing of UI/UX, email delivery, and link expiration.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **Given** I am on the login page and click "Forgot Password", **when** I enter my registered email address, **then** I receive an email with a secure link to reset my password. 2. **And** the UI displays a message instructing me to check my spam folder. 3. **And** the reset link is valid for a limited time (e.g., 1 hour). 4. **And** I can set a new password meeting the strength requirements.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: User authentication will be handled by Supabase Auth using email and password. Password reset functionality will leverage Supabase Auth.

artifact.snippet: This epic focuses on enabling secure user account creation and management, providing a personalized and protected space for their study materials.

constraint.description: New password must meet strength requirements (5 letters, 1 number, 1 special symbol).
Reset link valid for a limited time (e.g., 1 hour).
Integration with email delivery service for sending password reset links.
Utilize Supabase Auth for all password reset functionality.

tests.standards: The project uses Jest for unit and integration testing with coverage reporting. Different levels of testing are expected: unit for UI/client-side logic, integration for API endpoints, and end-to-end for full user flows. Manual testing for UI/UX is also part of the standard.

idea.description: Verify "Forgot Password" UI submits email and API endpoint triggers secure email with reset link.
Verify UI displays a message instructing user to check spam folder after reset request.
Verify reset link expires after a limited time (e.g., 1 hour).
Verify new password UI enforces strength requirements and API endpoint validates it.
